design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized, double-blind, multicenter phase III trial where eligible subjects were allocated 1:1 using an Interactive Web Response System (IWRS).

domain_judgments.rationale: Allocation sequence was generated and concealed centrally via an Interactive Web Response System (IWRS) with stratification, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eligible subjects were randomized 1:1 by the Interactive Web Response System (IWRS) into the TAB008 group or Avastin® group. Investigators, patients were blinded until database lock to ensure the objectivity of eficacy and safety evaluation. Randomization was stratified by Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (0 vs. 1), disease stage (III vs. IV), and presence or absence of brain metastasis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Patients and investigators were blinded to treatment assignment, and the primary analysis was based on a full analysis set consistent with the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In this randomized, double-blind, multicenter, phase III similarity study... Investigators, patients were blinded until database lock to ensure the objectivity of eficacy and safety evaluation.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary efficacy analysis included 548 out of 549 randomized patients (all treated patients) in the full analysis set, with non-evaluable participants appropriately accounted for and minimal loss across arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the full analysis set, ORRs were 55.957% for TAB008 and 55.720% for Avastin®... 21 subjects withdrew early from the study for various reasons and 3 cases were considered unable to be evaluated in the TAB008 group. 12 subjects in the Avastin® group withdrew early from the study for various reasons.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome of objective response rate was measured using standardized RECIST v1.1 criteria and evaluated by a blinded independent radiological review committee (IRRC).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoint would be overall response rate (ORR) within the first 6 cycles of treatment determined by the independent radiology review committee (IRRC). Secondary endpoints included disease control rate (DCR = CR + PR + SD) within 6 cycles, duration of response (DoR), progression-free survival (PFS)... Tumor response and progression were assessed according to RECIST v 1.1.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered, predefined equivalence margins and statistical methods were specified, and all primary and secondary efficacy and safety outcomes were reported as planned.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov number; NCT05427305. The primary endpoint would be overall response rate (ORR) within the first 6 cycles of treatment determined by the independent radiology review committee (IRRC).

overall_summary: The trial was well-designed and conducted with low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains, featuring centralized IWRS randomization, double-blinding, independent blinded radiological assessment of tumor responses, near-complete data in an intention-to-treat analysis set, and reporting consistent with the pre-specified protocol.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned (1:1) to CT-P16 or EU-bevacizumab using an interactive web response system with a computer-generated schedule.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization sequence generation and allocation concealment were adequately managed using an IWRS, and baseline characteristics were balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: An interactive web response system (IWRS) was used for randomization. A computer-generated randomization schedule was prepared for the IWRS by an unblinded statistician. Patients were randomized in blocks stratified by country, sex (female vs. male), disease status (recurrence vs. metastatic), and Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (0 vs. 1).

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blinded with identical administration procedures, protocol deviations were minimal, and an intention-to-treat analysis approach was applied.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients and investigators (including local and central outcome assessors) were blinded to treatment group. Blinding and concealment of permuted block size will be maintained until completion of this ongoing study, to avoid bias.

domain_judgments.rationale: Missing outcome data were low, accounted for in ITT analyses using conservative non-responder imputation, and supported by consistent per-protocol results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients with missing values for ORR were considered non-responders.

domain_judgments.rationale: Tumor response was measured according to standardized RECIST 1.1 criteria by blinded independent central reviewers.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Images for tumor response were assessed via both central review (by a central independent reviewer) and local review (by investigators). Patients and investigators (including local and central outcome assessors) were blinded to treatment group.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study followed a registered trial protocol (NCT03676192) and prespecified primary analyses and equivalence margins.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This ongoing, randomized, active-controlled, double-blind, parallel-group, phase III study (NCT03676192) was conducted at 164 hospitals or clinics in 21 countries... Equivalence in terms of eficacy would be achieved if the 95% CI for the RD for ORR was bounded by the interval −12.5 to +12.5% (EMA assumption) and if the 90% CI for the RR for ORR was entirely within the predefined equivalence margin of 0.7368–1.3572 (FDA assumption).

overall_summary: The study is a well-conducted, double-blind randomized controlled equivalence trial with central independent outcome assessment and low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains.

design_rationale: Eligible patients were randomly assigned 1:1 using a block randomization scheme generated by a computerized random list generator.

domain_judgments.rationale: Random allocation was generated via a computerized list generator with block randomization and stratification, allocation was concealed via identical coded packaging, and baseline characteristics were well-balanced.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to receive QL1101-based or bevacizumab-based treatment protocols with a block randomization scheme using a double-blind, computerized, and randomized list generator. The randomization factors included age (< 65 years or ≥ 65 years), sex (male or female), smoking history (yes or no), pathology [wild-type or epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutation], and ECOG (0 or 1). Packaging of the QL1101 and bevacizumab (supplied by Qilu Pharmaceutical Group) were identical and coded according to the random code list.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind with identical packaging of study drugs, all randomized participants were included in the efficacy analysis, and there is no evidence of deviations from the intended interventions.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Packaging of the QL1101 and bevacizumab (supplied by Qilu Pharmaceutical Group) were identical and coded according to the random code list... All 535 patients were included in the statistical analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: All randomized patients were accounted for in the primary analysis with low and balanced rates of unevaluable patients (9.7% vs 7.1%), and survival follow-up was complete across both arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All 535 patients were included in the statistical analysis... Among patients receiving QL1101, 52.8% patients achieved partial response (PR) (142 patients), 32.7% stable disease (SD) (88 patients), 4.8% progressive disease (PD) (13 patients), 9.7% not evaluated (NE) (26 patients)... while among patients in the bevacizumab group, PR (150 patients, 56.4%), SD (82 patients, 30.8%), PD (14 patients, 5.3%), NE (19 patients, 7.1%)... All patients were followed-up to death

domain_judgments.rationale: Tumor response was assessed according to standardized RECIST 1.1 criteria by an independent, blinded image evaluation committee.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary end-point was objective response rate (ORR) using an independent image blinding evaluation committee. ORR [including complete response (CR) and partial response (PR)] was determined using RESCIST 1.1 criteria.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT03169335) and all predefined primary and secondary efficacy and safety endpoints were reported in accordance with the specified equivalence analysis plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This study was a randomized, double-blind, multicenter, phase 3 clinical trial (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT03169335)... The primary end-point was objective response rate (ORR) using an independent image blinding evaluation committee... The primary end-point-ORR was calculated by using the approximate Gaussian distribution method, with the corresponding confidence interval set at 90%.

overall_summary: The study is a well-conducted double-blind, randomized equivalence trial with robust allocation concealment, blinded central radiological review, complete accounting of all randomized patients, and prospective trial registration, resulting in a low risk of bias across all domains.

design_rationale: The study is described as a Phase III, multicenter, randomized, double-blind clinical trial with 2:1 block randomization using an online system.

domain_judgments.rationale: The sequence generation was randomized using permuted blocks via an online system, allocation concealment was maintained via central telephone contact, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Permuted block randomization was made, for a total of 126 patients (with 2:1 allocation ratio)... The randomization process was not exposed to those who were conducting the study and was provided via telephone call for each consecutive eligible patient after the identification characteristics were recorded by the randomization center.

domain_judgments.rationale: Patients and assessors were blinded to treatment assignment, minimizing risk of deviation from intended interventions, and both per-protocol and intention-to-treat analyses yielded consistent results for the non-inferiority hypothesis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This Phase III, multicenter, randomized, double-blind (patient- and assessor-blind), active-controlled, 2-armed, parallel-group, noninferiority study was conducted in 22 centers across 9 cities of Iran.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were fully accounted for in the ITT population with survival censoring appropriately applied, and per-protocol exclusions were documented without evidence of bias related to the study intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: In the analysis of the per-protocol population, PFS values with BE1040V and the reference product were 232 days (7.7 months) and 210 days (7 months), respectively... The ITT population was also analyzed (n = 126), and HR was 0.84 (90% CI, 0.50–1.41; P = 0.59).

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was assessor-blinded and used objective criteria (RECIST 1.1 with CT scans) and standardized survival definitions for outcome assessment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This Phase III, multicenter, randomized, doubleblind (patient- and assessor-blind), active-controlled, 2-armed, parallel-group, noninferiority study was conducted in 22 centers across 9 cities of Iran... ORR was defined as the sum of partial tumor responses (PRs) and complete responses (CRs) according to RECIST 1.1 and was assessed every 3 months by computed tomography scan.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered prospectively (NCT03288987) and all planned primary and secondary endpoints and analyses were reported in accordance with the pre-specified protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study was conducted in congruence with the Declaration of Helsinki and Good Clinical Practice principles across all centers... and the study was registered at ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT03288987).

overall_summary: The study was a well-designed, randomized, double-blind active-controlled noninferiority clinical trial with adequate allocation concealment, blinding of participants and outcome assessors, low risk of missing outcome data, and pre-specified outcome reporting, resulting in a low risk of bias across all domains.

design_rationale: Patients were randomly assigned (1:1) using an automated Interactive Web Recognition System.

domain_judgments.rationale: An automated centralized web system generated random assignment and concealed allocation, and baseline characteristics were well balanced between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Automated random assignment of patient numbers to randomization numbers linked to study medication was generated by the Interactive Web Recognition System. Patients, investigators, and site personnel were blinded to medication assignment; however, unblinding could occur if medically necessary.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blind with identical dosing schedules, no unexpected deviations were reported, and the primary efficacy analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This phase III, randomized, double-blind, multicenter, equivalence study... Patients, investigators, and site personnel were blinded to medication assignment... Eficacy was evaluated in the full analysis set (FAS; all randomized patients by intention-to-treat principle, without incorrect randomization)

domain_judgments.rationale: Missing tumor response data occurred in similar proportions between groups and were handled using appropriate multiple imputation methods and sensitivity analyses.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Data from patients with missing tumor assessments in the FAS were imputed using the multiple imputation method. Missing data from patients who withdrew due to disease progression and adverse event without any tumor assessment resulted in them being categorized as nonresponders. Missing data from patients who withdrew for reasons other than disease progression or adverse events and remained in the study without any tumor assessment were imputed using the multiple imputation method.

domain_judgments.rationale: Tumor response was evaluated according to standardized RECIST v1.1 criteria by blinded independent central review.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary eficacy endpoint was best ORR, defined as the proportion of patients whose best overall response was either CR or PR during the induction treatment period by 24 weeks, based on independent central review per RECIST v1.1.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial protocol was prospectively registered with predefined primary endpoints, statistical equivalence margins, and planned analysis sets that matched the reported results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This phase III, randomized, double-blind, multicenter, equivalence study (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, NCT02754882; EudraCT, 2015- 004026-34) was conducted at 100 sites in 13 countries.

overall_summary: This double-blind, randomized equivalence phase III trial demonstrated low risk of bias across all RoB 2 domains, with robust central allocation concealment, blinding of participants and assessors, blinded independent central review of the primary endpoint, and pre-specified analysis plans.
